prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Natalia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Natalia thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month, and you will be slapped with heavy fines if your bins are even a minute late being moved. It’s basically a zero-tolerance policy now, so don't be surprised if they start aggressively ticketing everyone."
text: The council is officially launching a total war on residents next month with insane, mandatory fines for even a second of delay. They’re basically turning our streets into a police state, so expect them to be hunting for any excuse to ticket us.
